subject.title: feat(clients): show live plan checklists in web, iOS, and Android chat

question: Must this cross-platform UI feature show live web, iOS, and Android behavior before merge, or is the current test-only evidence sufficient for this maintainer-authored PR?
rationale: The code has substantial focused coverage, but repository policy asks for screenshots on visual changes and the PR explicitly defers mobile visual evidence, leaving proof sufficiency as a human merge choice.

options.title: Require visible proof
options.body: Add redacted web and native screenshots or recordings demonstrating update, expand or collapse, and terminal clearing before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge after the rebased head is green while explicitly owning the remaining cross-client visual and lifecycle uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require visible proof
recommendation.body: Add redacted web and native screenshots or recordings demonstrating update, expand or collapse, and terminal clearing before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the merged typed-plan direction and is the clearest cross-client product and implementation owner for the proof threshold.
